comment: Single source of truth for the multi-repository workspace. Consumed by workspace/bootstrap.sh; .cursor/environment.json and scripts/cloud-workspace-install.sh carry older hardcoded copies of this list and should converge on this file (modernization roadmap, section 2.1 / Phase 0).

repos.name: workspace
repos.role: private session anchor (the workspace root itself)
repos.note: sessions start here; never cloned as a sibling, so any non-active status keeps the bootstrap from touching it

repos.name: PyDevices.github.io
repos.role: pages site + simulator + mip index host

repos.name: audioif
repos.note: in-flight instrument-library program; hands off until complete

repos.name: lvgl-bindings
repos.role: generated-bindings producer (single writer of the lvgl sync)

repos.name: lvgl-python
repos.note: sync target: edit helpers only in lvgl-bindings

repos.name: micropython-vst3
repos.note: no GitHub remote yet; becomes active when published

repos.name: micropython-pydevices
repos.role: MicroPython runtime overlay: patch queue, profiles, wasm variant
